name: Chicken Couscous
assumptions: Yield estimated from total dry ingredients (approx. 200g couscous + 200g chicken + vegetables) and typical one-pan Moroccan couscous portion size of 350-450g cooked per serving for a main meal.
Preparation time summed from explicit instruction steps (onion 2 min + chicken 10 min + harissa 1 min + soak 5 min) plus 7 min for prep/chopping/ grating, rounded to nearest 5 min interval.
Couscous contains wheat (durum semolina); wheat allergen true, gluten-free false.
Harissa may contain sesame or other undeclared allergens in some blends, left null.
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts or peanuts in listed ingredients.
Chicken stock assumed to be a prepared liquid without undisclosed allergens or animal products beyond chicken.
instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion for 1-2 mins just until softened. Add the chicken and fry for 7-10 mins until cooked through and the onions have turned golden. Grate over the ginger, stir through the harissa to coat everything and cook for 1 min more.

Tip in the apricots, chickpeas and couscous, then pour over the stock and stir once. Cover with a lid or tightly cover the pan with foil and leave for about 5 mins until the couscous has soaked up all the stock and is soft. Fluff up the couscous with a fork and scatter over the coriander to serve. Serve with extra harissa, if you like.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Standard olive oil density ~0.91 g/ml; 1 tbsp = 13.6 g. Pure fat, so protein/carbs/fiber zero.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: Medium onion ~110 g when chopped; typical raw white/yellow onion values used.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.assumptions: Raw boneless skinless chicken breast; values reflect typical raw state before cooking.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of grated fresh ginger estimated at 2 g (small amount for flavor in one-pan dish); typical raw ginger root values.

ingredients.name: Harissa Spice
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons harissa paste/spice blend estimated at ~15 g per tbsp; typical North African harissa values used (calories from oil/spices).

ingredients.name: Dried Apricots
ingredients.assumptions: 10 dried apricots average ~4 g each (small/medium size common in recipes); typical unsulfured dried apricot values.

ingredients.name: Chickpeas
ingredients.assumptions: 220 g canned chickpeas, drained weight (common can size yields ~220-240 g drained); values for drained chickpeas.

ingredients.name: Couscous
ingredients.assumptions: Dry couscous (absorbs the 200 ml stock); standard uncooked durum wheat couscous values.

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: 200 ml chicken stock ~200 g (density ~1 g/ml); typical low-sodium prepared stock values (mostly water).

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Handful of fresh coriander (cilantro) estimated at 10 g (typical garnish amount); standard fresh herb values.
